reader_summary.overview: Raelan Lambert, John Jackson, and Erik Sebusch are three of the leaders at Mercer Alternatives, the alternative investment arm of the consulting juggernaut. Mercer advises on $16.5 trillion of assets and manages $400 billion. Raelan is Mercer's Global Alternatives leader, John is the Head of Diversifying Alternatives, its hedge fund group.
